separation_notes: This episode separates models mainly on schema precision. The best signal would preserve uncertainty while still naming the nnU-Net v2-specific field shapes and path conventions. Here, the planner stayed cautious on many unknowns but missed several critical v2-specific details and added at least one wrong default. The worker correctly stayed guarded, but did not independently recover the hidden v2 schema facts.
concise_rationale: The planner preserved some uncertainty but failed to carry the most important hidden nnU-Net v2 constraints: dict-shaped channel_name, string-key labels, exact filename conventions, relative path prefixes, file_ending, and tensorImageSize omission. It also introduced a misleading label example. The worker remained cautious and safe, but the handoff was still too weak for a robust implementation.
